# Third-party material used by the 3D map

| What | Where | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Three.js r180 (`three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`) | `public/vendor/three/` | MIT (see `public/vendor/three/LICENSE`) | https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js |
| Three.js add-ons (post-processing passes, shaders, `RoundedBoxGeometry`, `GLTFLoader`, `RGBELoader`, `BufferGeometryUtils`, `Sky`, `SimplexNoise`) | `public/vendor/three/addons/` | MIT (same licence) | `examples/jsm/` of the same release |

Everything else in the 3D scene (terrain, water, trees, grass, buildings, dice, textures) is generated by code in
`public/map3d*.js`; no photographs, scanned textures or other people's models are used at the moment.

If textures or models from outside are added later, list them here with name, author, licence (CC0 / MIT only), URL and date.
| pdf.js 4.10.38 worker (`pdf.worker.min.mjs`, copied unchanged from the `pdfjs-dist` package already used by the server importer) | `public/vendor/pdfjs/` | Apache-2.0 (see `public/vendor/pdfjs/LICENSE`) | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js |
